_comment: Paragraph style CSS for text color and outline (#215). Read by text-color.test.js (buildStyleCssBlock) and tests/Unit/ParagraphStylesTextColorTest.php (generate_style_css), so both generators are held to the same text. css is the whole output for style id 8 (with legacyId when given); an empty string means the style writes no CSS.

cases.label: palette color with its saved fallback
palette color with no fallback (a palette color that is not hex)
custom color with transparency (a tint)
short hex is expanded and lowercased
outline-only text: transparent fill, palette outline behind the fill
transparent fill without an outline color writes no color
transparent fill without an outline writes nothing
outline on top in the text color, half a pixel
outline width capped at 20px and rounded to two decimals
outline width rounded to two decimals
outline color and position without a width write nothing
an invalid color writes nothing
color after the other declarations, block color rule after the alignment rule
fit to width keeps its color and outline
the block color rule comes before the core-block hang rules
a legacy id gets its own block color selector
outline-only text: a palette outline with no fallback uses the system text color when the theme lacks it
outline-only text: a palette outline with a fully transparent fallback uses the system text color too
a palette outline with no fallback on filled text needs no system color (it falls back to the fill)
a transparent fill with a fully transparent outline color writes no color
a nearly transparent outline color still counts as the outline of transparent text
